item.title: Totally 80’s Saturday Night
item.description: Each Saturday starting at 7pm, Ralphie Aversa plays nothing but the biggest 80's hits from the hair bands to the songs you didn't know you forgot PLUS the movies, the tv shows, the fashion and more!

item.title: ‘Business of the Day’ presented by Chocolate Carousel
item.description: 107.1 The Boss wants to brighten up your workday with a delicious delivery from Chocolate Carousel in Wall. We could be stopping by your work place with a 107.1 The Boss gift box filled with Cake Pops, Chocolate Covered Pretzels, Assorted Baked Goods and more for you and your co-workers!

item.title: Jersey Shore Matters with Valerie Segraves
item.description: Jersey Shore Matters is your go-to source for all things related to New Jersey, with a special emphasis on the vibrant Jersey Shore area. Each episode is packed with compelling news, insightful information, and in-depth discussions that highlight the diverse and dynamic nature of the region.

item.title: Win ‘Em Before You Can Buy ‘Em: Almost Queen at the Count Basie Center for the Arts in Red Bank – April 19th!
item.description: Listen to Michele Amabile every midday for your chance to win a pair of tickets before you can buy them! For more info visit thebasie.org!

item.title: ‘Make a Difference Mondays’ Presented By New Jersey Natural Gas
item.description: Every Monday morning, 107.1 The Boss and New Jersey Natural Gas will be highlighting a different Nonprofit that “Makes A Difference” in our community with interviews you can listen to right here. Plus, enter for your chance to win a Nest Thermostat and $100 in NJ Lottery scratch-off tickets! On this 'Make a Difference Monday', we are talking to Matt Brazinski of NJNG!

item.title: Apps & Streaming
item.description: Wake up with Greg T in the Morning with Rochelle — weekday mornings on 107.1 The Boss! Join Jersey native and radio legend Greg T, alongside Rochelle Gagnon, for the perfect mix of high-energy laughs, real conversations, and local flavor. It’s everything you love about mornings in the Garden State!

item.title: Enter to Win Tickets to 107.1 The Boss Presents A Flock of Seagulls at Asbury Lanes on April 3rd
item.description: 107.1 The Boss Presents A Flock of Seagulls at Asbury Lanes on April 3rd, and we have a pair of tickets for you. Don’t miss your chance to relive the era of big hair, synth-driven anthems, and timeless classics. Enter now for your chance to win.
